name: rig
comment: Starting point for running rig inside a container.
rig's isolated worktree separates file work; it is not a boundary against code execution.
That boundary is the container, and rig runs inside it.
`rig-wb hostcheck` reports whether the current session is actually bounded by one —
DEVCONTAINER=true above is what makes the check see this container.
Copy to .devcontainer/devcontainer.json and adjust the image to match your stack.
